font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\" style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003EA 55-year-old male, resident of Nalgonda, who is a farmer by occupation came to the hospital with chief complaints of breathlessness since 6 months\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E• HOPI\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic for 20 years then had muscle cramps, increased frequency of urination, and giddiness for which he went to hospital and was diagnosed with DM type II and is on medication (T.Glymiperide + Metformin) since then.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E1 year back he had generalized weakness, polydipsia, polyurea, and dizziness, visited the hospital and was found to have uncontrolled DM 2 and is on insulin ( since then.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EUntil 6 months ago he worked as a farmer, waking up at 5 am. he takes his breakfast at 7 am. Then he goes to work, has lunch at 1 pm. returns to home at 6-7 pm \u0026amp; has dinner at 8 pm, and goes to bed at 9 pm.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EBut 6 months back his whole life was changed when he was taken to the hospital after experiencing palpitations, dizziness, blurring of vision, and involuntary movements involving his upper limbs \u0026amp; body, where he was diagnosed with hypertension \u0026amp; Renal failure.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EH\/o SOB since 6 months NYHA 1-2 and from last 1-month shortness of breath increased NYHA 3-4, gradually progressive, associated with orthopnea \u0026amp; PND for which he came to our hospital.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EH\/o Low backache since 1 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EH\/o itching all over the body with darkening of skin since 1 month\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EH\/o decreased Urine output since 1 month\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo thin stream, poor flow, increased frequency, hesitancy, or Burning micturition present.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o Fever, Chest pain, Palpitations, Syncope\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o Cough\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo other complaints\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E•Past History :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EK\/c\/o DM-type II since 20 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EK\/c\/o hypertension since 6 months\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo history of asthma, TB, epilepsy, thyroid abnormalities\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E•\u003Cb\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EDiet: Mixed\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAppetite: Normal\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESleep: Disturbed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EBowel: Regular\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EBladder: Decreased urination.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHabits: Do not consume any form of alcohol or tobacco.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E●\u003Cb\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENot significant\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E●\u003Cb\u003EDRUG HISTORY\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHAI \u0026amp; NPH 3 units (three times a day) Insulin for the past 1 year,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETELMA for hypertension since the past 6 months\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E●\u003Cb\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThe patient was examined in a well-lit room after obtaining consent.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThe patient was conscious, coherent, and cooperative. He was moderately built and moderately nourished.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPallor: Absent\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESalt restriction \u0026lt;2g \/day\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EINJ HAI \u0026amp; NPH 3Units\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETab Lasix 40 mg BD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETab Nicardia 20 mg PO\/TID\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETab Arkmain 0.1mg PO\/TID\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETab Orofer -XT PO\/OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EA 50 years old male,\u0026nbsp; mason by occupation and resident of Bhongir, came to the hospital with\u0026nbsp;chief complaints\u0026nbsp;of fever since 2 months, and loss of appetite since 2 months.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHistory of presenting illness\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EA 50-year-old mason who was happily living with his family daily\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003Ewakes up at 5 am, goes for a walk to get milk, and returns home. He then has tea with biscuits and rice for breakfast, then leaves for his work by 9 am.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EHe has rice, for lunch, with curries at his workplace.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EHe comes back from work at either 7 or 8 pm.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EHe has rice for dinner at 9 pm and goes to sleep by 10 pm.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003EBut his happy life was not so happy from the last 2 months when\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;he developed Fever which was insidious in onset, intermittent in nature, low grade with no chills and rigors, no aggravating, and relieving with medication.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E2 months back while he was working he felt generalized weakness \u0026amp; body pains for which he left work early and went to home. The next\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;day morning he had fever for which he bought some tablets from a local pharmacy.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E2 days later he was taken to a local ayurvedic by his family members on suspicion of jaundice where he was given some herbal medicine 3 doses (1 dose\/week) and advised of some dietary restrictions.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EEven after 3 weeks, his fever doesn't come down and he felt no change in his general condition.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe also lost his appetite gradually since 2 months, and history of weight loss since 2 months.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESince 20 days, his fever increased usually more in the evenings which would continue the whole night, and reduce by morning, and is associated with chills for which he was brought to our hospital.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient also complained of on \u0026amp; off pain in the abdomen in the umbilical and right lumbar region, which was insidious in onset, gradually progressive, non-radiating, aggravated while walking (around 100 meters), and relieved on rest.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EH\/o burning micturition present\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o urgency, frequency, incontinence, polyuria, polydipsia, nocturia, or urethral discharge.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o sore throat, cough, or cold\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o vomiting, diarrhea\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o rash over the body, bleeding gums, Malena\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo h\/o headache, photophobia, involuntary movements, altered behavior\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo H\/o pedal edema, SOB, chest palpitations, chest pain, and tightness.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPast History\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient is a known case of pulmonary tuberculosis 25 years ago, for which he used ATT for 6 months.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENot a known case of DM, HTN, CVA, CAD, thyroid disorders, asthma, and epilepsy.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPersonal history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EDiet - mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAppetite - decreased since 2 month\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EBowel \u0026amp; Bladder habits: Regular\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESleep - decreased\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAddictions - 90 ml occasionally since 35 years.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EFamily history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENo similar complaints\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ESurgical history\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAppendicectomy was done 30 years ago\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGeneral examination\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EExamination was done in a well-lighted room, with consent and informing the patient in the presence of a female attendant.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient was conscious, coherent, and cooperative, well oriented to time, place, and person.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPallor - present\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EIcterus- absent\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ECyanosis- absent\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EClubbing - absent\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ELymphadenopathy- absent\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPedal edema - absent\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDefinition:\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EMany authors consider the age of 45 years as the upper limit for stroke in young.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EEpidemiology:\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAbout 10-15% of strokes occur in younger patients, constituting approximately 2 million adolescents and young adults worldwide who suffer from an ischaemic stroke.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ERisk factors:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EConventional risk factors like Diabetes Mellitus, Hypertension, and dyslipidemia.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ERisk factors for stroke in young include smoking, alcohol, and drug abuse: cocaine IV drug users, and oral contraceptive pills.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EMigraine with aura, Malignancy\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EEtiology:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E1)\u0026nbsp;\u003Cu\u003ECardiac causes:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E30% of stroke in young is secondary to cardiac causes: Congenital heart disease, PFO,\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAtrial fibrillation, Acute MI, cardiomyopathy, Endocarditis, Cardiac tumors like atrial myxoma\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E2) \u003Cu\u003ENoninflammatory Nonatherosclerotic causes:\u003C\/u\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EArterial dissection, Marfans, Radition vasculopathy, Migraine, Fibromuscular dysplasia, CADASIL.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E3) \u003Cu\u003EInflammatory:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETakayasu arteritis, Giant cell arteritis, Kawasaki disease, PAN, Churg Strauss, Wegner, microscopic Polyangiitis.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E4) \u003Cu\u003EInfections:\u003C\/u\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHIV, Tuberculosis, Hepatitis B, syphilis\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003E5)\u0026nbsp;\u003Cu\u003EHypercoagulable states:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: medium;\"\u003EProtein C, protein S and antithrombin III deficiency, APLA, hyperhomocysteinemia, factor v leiden mutation, Sickle cell.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr
